description: This file contains the definition of the ContactFeed class, which extends FeedLogicBase to handle feed updates for Contact records within the SuiteCRM application. It defines a method to push feed notifications when a new contact is created.

classes.name: ContactFeed
classes.description: A class extending FeedLogicBase to manage activity feeds for Contact entities, mainly to push updates when contacts are created.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Creates a feed notification when a new contact is created, including the contact's name and ID, and pushes it via SugarFeed if applicable.
